blocks.x: Ben Webster, that's boy. A boy here in town right now by the name of Johnny Williams, Mary Lou's first husband.
Yeah, baritone, used to be with Andy Kirk.

No, he hasn't played in years. Yeah, John Williams, there's some rough son of a guns out there. Playwise, you know, playing. I'll never forget one time we were all up to Clyde's house. This was Ben Webster and Eddy Basfield and me and Basie was up there. Well see, Eddy Basfield and all them know Basie from way back there in Kansas City, you know, like they were with Benny Moton and so boy they got Basie out of the apartment and out near the elevator and Eddie Basfield start punching on Basie. He says, 'Aw man, you think you're something because they call you Count Basie. We're all boys together, don't you
remember us when we were all down there 15th and Paseo in Kansas City? You're Count Basie, bam. And hit him again. Oh no.
"Oh no, Eddie don't do that." "Aw, don't talk back to me, you know, kidding. Oh boy. Those were good old days, boy we used to have more fun.
